correctness.rationale: The two exact state recurrences cover 255 of 255 nonempty subsets. The direct Python and C++ greedy-merger recursions and Python endpoint-path recursion all agree; independent Hamilton-path DP and permutation optimum computations agree for every subset. Finite exhaustive proof has no extrapolation or statistical inference.

value.rationale: Binary is the smallest nontrivial alphabet and length three is a central benchmark in the recent exact greedy SCS approximation literature. The precise fixed-alphabet ratio 10/7 and full one-orbit extremizer classification demonstrate that the arbitrary-alphabet value 9/5 is not sharp for binary short reads. This supplies a complete natural minimum-alphabet reference for future fixed-alphabet greedy approximation research; it is not a random slice of parameters.
